name: RadioV2
description: An enhanced radio button component with built-in label and description text support. Renders a real <input type="radio"> for accessibility with a custom visual overlay. Supports checked, disabled, and error states.

notes: A real <input type="radio"> is rendered and visually hidden; the styled circle is a presentation layer.
Focus indicator appears on the visual radio via :focus-visible using var(--color-border-focus).
When error is true, the border uses var(--color-border-danger).
The label is associated with the input via htmlFor/id pairing.
The description is linked via aria-describedby for screen reader access.
Touch target is at minimum 44px via min-block-size on the wrapper.

onChange.description: Called with true when the radio is selected.

name.description: Name attribute for the native input. Groups radios with the same name.

value.description: Value attribute for the native input.

label.description: Primary label text rendered next to the radio.

description.description: Secondary description text rendered below the label.

disabled.description: Disables the radio. Prevents interaction and reduces visual emphasis.

error.description: Shows an error state. Border colour changes to var(--color-border-danger).

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the wrapper element.

do: Always provide a label for accessibility.
Use description to provide additional context when the label alone is insufficient.
Group radios with the same name attribute for mutually exclusive selection.
Use error alongside a visible error message to communicate validation failures.
dont: Do not use a single radio alone — always provide at least two options.
Do not leave a radio without a label.
Do not use for multi-select choices — use CheckboxV2 instead.
